questions.q: Sinusitis with thick, tough, stringy, yellow-green discharge and pain at the root of the nose calls for:
questions.why: Ropy, stringy discharge with pressure pain at the root of the nose is the keynote of Kali bichromicum.

questions.q: Burning pains relieved by heat, or a dry mouth without thirst, are examples of:
questions.why: They contradict what is expected, which makes them peculiar symptoms of high value (Organon §153).

questions.q: The dependency ratio is calculated as:
opts: population aged 65 and above / total population
questions.why: The dependency ratio relates the economically dependent young and old to the working-age population of 15-64 years.

questions.q: The second booster of DPT vaccine under the UIP is given at:
questions.why: DPT booster-1 is at 16–24 months and booster-2 at 5–6 years; Td follows at 10 and 16 years.

questions.q: Copious, acrid, excoriating discharge from the nose with bland lachrymation suggests:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Euphrasia is the reverse: bland coryza, acrid tears.

questions.q: 'Relationship of Remedies and Sides of the Body', a standard reference on complementary and inimical remedies, was written by:
questions.why: R. Gibson Miller's small book lists the complementary, inimical, antidotal and following remedies, and the sides of the body each affects.

questions.q: Remedies such as X-ray, Magnetis polus and Sol are drawn from which source?
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Imponderabilia are 'weightless' energies: X-ray, magnetism, sunlight, electricity.

questions.q: Secretin stimulates the pancreas to secrete juice rich in:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Cholecystokinin stimulates enzyme secretion and gallbladder contraction.

questions.q: Headache of schoolchildren, especially girls at puberty, in thin, growing children is characteristic of:
questions.why: Calcarea phos: headache of school girls, with growing pains and slow bone development (Boericke).

questions.q: In homoeopathic pharmacy, the symbol Φ denotes:
questions.why: Φ marks the mother tincture, the starting preparation of a plant drug.
